meta.title: Ocean Information & Services Solutions Blueprint
meta.subtitle: What we're hearing so far
meta.note: Results are summarized from six unique respondents. Where a person submitted more than once, the most recent submission is used.

rioOutcomes.title: Build on solutions that already work
rioOutcomes.detail: 67% selected existing and emerging solutions that can be scaled.

rioOutcomes.title: Create a shared view of priority needs
rioOutcomes.detail: 50% want the Blueprint to establish a shared assessment of priorities.

workshop.title: No single workshop format dominates
workshop.body: Preferences are split across hybrid sessions linked to existing events, regional or time-zone-based online sessions, small expert groups, and a combined online-plus-synthesis approach. A flexible, multi-format process may serve the group best.

takeaway.title: Success is not more ocean information. It is ocean information being used.
takeaway.body: Across the responses, the clearest through-line is the need to connect sustained observations to interoperable data, prediction, services, and decisions, while building the partnerships, capacity, and funding needed to sustain that work.
